message: Mapped dog and cat domestication, partner-recognition, endocrine, autonomic, developmental, genetic, and welfare evidence with explicit source boundaries.
Defined BRIDGE and separated ecological enablement, partner-specific behavior, peripheral association, candidate dyadic regulation, and molecular claims.
Specified 180 established dyads, owner/nonowner/barrier/control conditions, multimodal measures, competing models, welfare safeguards, and decision rules.
Produced and visually verified an 8-page IEEE-style design-only natural-science report with 11 numbered equations, 5 tables, 1 workflow figure, and 19 references.
